paper_caption: Colony morphology and microscopic characteristics of representative fungal isolates. Isolates were cultured on PDA at 25 °C for 7 days and microscopic features showing conidial structures: (A,B) Aspergillus aureoterreus RW12; (C,D) A. oryzae RW09; (E,F) A. fumigatus RC10; (G,H) A. tubingensis ; (I,J) A. awamori ; (K,L) Talaromyces pinophilus RW08; (M) Neocosmospora pseudensiformis RC15; (N) N. pseudensiformis RC15 cultured on carnation leaf agar. Scale bars = 20 μm.
